stories.title: Europe shrugs off hawkish Fed: Stoxx ~+0.6%, dollar at 7-week high

facts.text: Euronews (~09:55): Euro Stoxx 50 and Stoxx 600 opened over +0.6% Thursday after Wed’s first Fed hike since 2023; DAX/CAC/MIB/IBEX/AEX/CH20 roughly +0.2–0.7%; FTSE 100 led >+1%.
Wed US cash context (morning): Dow −1.2%, S&P −0.4%, Nasdaq ~flat into hawkish Warsh messaging (Euronews).
Dollar at a 7-week high vs majors; euro ~$1.146 (−0.5% from Wed open); 2y UST ~4.72%; 10y near 5% (Euronews).
Odds: another hike by December fully priced; ~50% chance as soon as October; Goldman flipped to consecutive hikes (Euronews).
BoE decision due later Thursday (hold expected); BoJ Friday (hike anticipated) (Euronews).

stories.whyItMatters: Morning covered the hawkish overnight US selloff; lunch is the European follow-through — risk assets steadier even as USD/yields keep October in play.

stories.title: EU gas storage only 69% full; €81/MWh (+150% YoY) tightens Merz weekend squeeze

facts.text: Reuters: EU gas storages 69% full vs ~85% five-year average for this date (Gas Infrastructure Europe).
TTF benchmark ~€81/MWh (+150% YoY), above the ECB’s “adverse” path; Morgan Stanley sees risk toward €100/MWh depending on weather.
Germany + Netherlands (35% of EU capacity) are major laggards — high prices after Iran-war disruption deterred restocking bets that the war would end quickly.
Petrol +24% / diesel +38% YoY across the EU; jet fuel >+100%; ECB’s Kazimir says focus shifting from oil to gas/electricity.
Political overlay: AfD win last week + Sunday Berlin/MV votes tighten pressure on Merz for costly fuel-price relief (Reuters).

stories.whyItMatters: Storage lag into winter + far-right energy politics collide with Sunday’s state polls — not just a commodity print.

stories.title: IMK more than doubles 2026 Germany growth forecast to 1.3%

facts.text: IMK (Thu): GDP +1.3% in 2026 (was 0.6%); +1.4% in 2027 (was 0.9%) — stronger H1 exports + defence/infrastructure spending.
Sebastian Dullien: location “more resilient than many recent dire predictions,” but recovery not self-sustaining amid high energy prices and policy uncertainty.
Private consumption only +0.1 pp to growth; government consumption (incl. armed forces/ammo) +0.7 pp.
Inflation forecast 2.7% (2026) / 2.9% (2027); unemployment stays 6.4% both years. Ifo/DIW/RWI also recently raised forecasts.

stories.whyItMatters: Counterweight to the energy-politics gloom — institutes see a defence/infra-led rebound even as households stay squeezed.

stories.title: EU asks China for voluntary hybrid-export curbs (~15% EU share) — FT

facts.text: SPIEGEL/FT (~10:18): Brussels asked Beijing to voluntarily limit Chinese hybrid sales to ~15% of the EU market to avert a trade fight.
SPIEGEL/FT: EU official — if China won’t limit hybrid exports, “werden wir es tun”; framed as stopping industrial decline / managed trade.
Also: curb other exports (e.g. chemicals) and buy more EU goods; Šefčovič wants tangible results by October, trip early next month (SPIEGEL).
Context: von der Leyen Wed SOTEU called the €360.6bn China deficit “untenable” (+9% H1) and warned of a second “China shock” (SPIEGEL).
CNEV Post (FT): hybrid imports from China rose from 3,800 (Oct 2024) to 50,000 (Jul 2026); BEVs already face up to ~45% duties vs ~10% on hybrids.

stories.whyItMatters: Follows Wed’s SOTEU China-shock framing with a concrete hybrid VER ask — escalation path if Beijing refuses.

image.alt: Rear three-quarter view of a white BYD Seal 07 DM-i plug-in hybrid sedan at the 2026 Beijing Auto Show.

stories.title: Huawei Connect: Ascend 960 NPO supernode — 4,096 chips, up to 8 EFLOPS FP8

facts.text: TechNode: at Huawei Connect 2026 (Shanghai), Huawei billed an NPO-based Ascend 960 supernode as industry-first near-packaged optics scale-up.
Config cited: 4,096 Ascend 960 chips via Hi-ONE — up to 8 EFLOPS FP8 and 1 PB HBM; 5,500 Hi-ONE units said to replace 40,000 800G modules, cutting >550 kW and claiming 99.8% availability.
Chip roadmap: Ascend 960 development “ahead of schedule”; 960DT planned Q1 2027, 960PR Q3 2027; >1,000 Ascend 910C supernodes deployed; 950 in commercial use.
SCMP: UnifiedBus + Hi-ONE aimed at connecting up to ~4,000 processors; Atlas 960 SuperPoD claims ~2.3×/2.5× training/inference gains vs Atlas 950 on 10T-parameter models.

stories.whyItMatters: China’s Nvidia-alternative stack is shipping a concrete optical supernode story on the same day Europe debates Chinese industrial capacity.
